notes.title: Update 1.17
notes.content:
This update brings a few stability fixes. In the coming weeks, there will be a couple more updates focusing on further improving existing features, including much more customization to exporting.
[list]
[*] Added better explanation to the encryption dialog, as well as backup buttons.
[*] Added automatic configuration recovery in case it somehow corrupts, which is a rare bug.
[*] Fix crash when loading certain documents.
[*] Fix invalid counting in word statistics in certain situations.
[*] Fix a bug where the text area's padding is invalid on first startup.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
You've been asking for features, and we're happy to bring them to you. The Steam forums have been busy, and so have we. Thanks for all the feedback and suggestions so far!

[list][*]Added the ability to put notes in folders (tags). Right click a note and click "Set tag" to set its tag.
[*]Note models now have an "Edit" option when right clicking it in the notes list.
[*]Allow italic text in between quotes, "[i]like this[/i]".
[*]Fixed weird artifacts in some exports.
[*]Spell checking label now has a hand cursor (like a link) to make it more clear that it's click-able.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.content:
Another day, another update. The changes here are mostly stability fixes, but also an important new setting for themes that workshop authors have been asking for. No more screen resolution matching!

As of this update, Nimble Writer is also available DRM-free on [url=http://nimble.itch.io/writer]Itch.io[/url]. Steam users have been asking for a DRM-free version for a while, and we'll be looking into giving all Steam users the ability to get the Itch.io version [i]for free[/i], so look forward to that in the future.
[list][*]Added the ability to stretch background images instead of tiling them. (Checkbox in the settings dialog.)
[*]Fixed Nimble Writer sometimes hanging in the background due to a stuck thread.
[*]Fixed several crashes and annoyances caused by instable word counter.
[*]Updated the zip library used to save and load documents, which fixes a couple crashes and glitches.
[*]Fixed crash when encrypted file couldn't be opened and user tries to save directly after.
[/list]

[*]Updated the zip library used to save and load documents, which fixes a couple crashes and glitches.
[*]Fixed crash when encrypted file couldn't be opened and user tries to save directly after.

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
After some very busy weeks of a (secret) project involving Nimble Writer, here's another update that will fix a lot of visual problems that you guys have reported on the Steam forum.

[list][*]Added a simple quickstart tutorial. (Existing users will also see this window the next time they start this update, but you can just click OK to get rid of it.)
[*]Added the ability to move notes up and down in the notes list.
[*]Changed the default notes width to 50%.
[*]Made it possible to import docx, odt, and rtf files by "opening" them (from the load file dialog instead of the import dialog, both are possible now).
[*]Made it more clear that the note panel can be resized with the slider.
[*]Fixed an issue where closing the app right after setting Cloud Sync doesn't set the document up for cloud sync properly.
[*]Fixed notes not being able to get imported when they have uppercase filename extensions.
[*]Fixed a possible crash when a Workshop item you are subscribed to gets deleted by the author.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.content:
A little belated update, mostly due to business and time restraints, but we managed to get some nice fixes in this week. Yet again, thanks to everyone for the feedback!
[list][*]Added the ability to export to multiple categories in the Wordpress exporter.
[*]Added the ability to attach tags when exporting to Wordpress. (In our testing, we weren't able to actually get the tag list populated, which might be 
a Wordpress bug, but do let us know on the forums if it works for you!)
[*]Added Ukranian dictionary and thesaurus.
[*]Modified the way the Home and End keys work: they now navigate to the beginning or ending of the line instead of the ending of the paragraph.
[*]Fixed problem when entering some unicode characters in search field.
[*]Fixed problem with disappearing chapters when deleting the first chapter in a story.
[*]Fixed issue when typing a certain unicode character, which would then be rendered as "xDO" due to smart quotes.
[*]Fixed Workshop crash when updating an item file without updating the image.
[*]Fixed random crash when exporting to Wordpress with images attached.
[/list]

Don't forget about the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/348200/discussions/1/617336568082255860/]weekly writing challenges[/url]!

a Wordpress bug, but do let us know on the forums if it works for you!)
[*]Added Ukranian dictionary and thesaurus.

[*]Fixed Workshop crash when updating an item file without updating the image.
[*]Fixed random crash when exporting to Wordpress with images attached.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
This week's patch includes some much requested features and bugfixes. 
Also, if there are any Lua developers out there, we invite you to check out our [url=https://github.com/NimbleTools/NimbleWriterDocs/wiki]updated addon documentation on Github[/url]. Addons can be developed in Lua, and can be submitted to the Steam Workshop for everyone to see.

[list][*]Added automatic smart quotes, “like these”. This feature can be configured in the metadata settings of the current document.
[*]Added a random name generator. It's located in the addons menu (the Star button) and in the right click context menu.
[*]Added the ability to add cover images to ePub (metadata), PDF, and HTML exporters.
[*]Added a new default (light) theme: “Sky Blue”
[*]Added a “Browse” button for program background image in the settings dialog.
[*]Added addon permission "USERINFO" which gives access to the [url=https://github.com/NimbleTools/NimbleWriterDocs/wiki/AddonLibUser]user lib[/url].
[*]Added an error when attempting to upload images to the Steam Workshop that are bigger than 1 MB.
[*]Fixed first word in paragraphs other than the first paragraph not being capable of having formatting.
[*]Fixed possible crash with image and doodle notes.
[*]Fixed spellchecker reporting errors on spans of characters that are not actually words.
[*]Fixed a problem with LanguageTool sometimes hanging on big stories.
[*]Fixed a problem with LanguageTool not properly using UTF-8 encoding in some cases.
[*]Fixed layout issues in HTML exporting dialog.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
As promised, we'll be doing weekly updates. They will either release on friday or saturday.

Yet again, thanks to everyone for their feedback on the Steam forums! It really helps us get the best out of Nimble Writer.
[list][*]Added a setting to change how paragraphs are defined. They can now be set as one per line, or separated by an empty line. This can be changed in the metadata dialog, and in the "Defaults" panel in the settings.
[*]Added a more detailed way of adding images to a document. Note that not all exporters will respect all settings equally yet.
[*]Added the option to have a clock in fullscreen mode. This can be toggled in the application settings.

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
This update brings more fixes and features based on community feedback.

[list][*]Added .txt exporter, which can export to several formats: plaintext, markdown, HTML tags, and bbcode tags (for forums and such).
[*]Added synonyms (thesaurus). Select a word, then right click and navigate to the synonyms option.
[*]Added "Move to" and "Copy to" options when right clicking a piece of text. You can choose to move or copy the selected text to a new chapter or text note.
[*]Added the ability to scroll some elements without having to click on them.
[*]Fixed visual issues on dropdown boxes.
[*]Fixed spellchecker not remembering words added to the custom dictionary on the same run.
[*]Fixed a crash with some lists when clicking anything that is not an item.
[*]Fixed some problems when searching for text containing unicode characters.
[*]Fixed a minor interface bug when items were deleted from lists.
[*]Fixed a minor problem related to undo/redo when switching chapters.
[*]Fixed the "Browse" button in the LanguageTool settings panel not working.
[*]Fixed the "Help" button in the Steam Workshop uploader dialog not working.
[*]Fixed some layout issues in the Steam Workshop uploader dialog.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
The second update for Nimble Writer is now available. An exporter that was much requested has been implemented (exporting to Docx), as well as a bunch of helpful keyboard shortcuts, so you don't have to reach for the mouse as often.

We're eager to make Nimble Writer even better, so let us know what you think!
[list][*]Added a Docx exporter. Please report all problems with this.
[*]Added Ctrl+Shift+PageUp and Ctrl+Shift+PageDown for quickly scrolling through notes.
[*]Added Ctrl+E, Ctrl+R and Ctrl+J for Center, Right, and Justify alignments, respectively.
[*]Added Ctrl+Shift+A for adding a new note.
[*]Added Ctrl+Tab for quickly switching input focus between editor and text note.
[*]Improved general keyboard-accessibility.
[*]Improved the Steam Cloud dialog to be more clear, and added a disclaimer.
[*]Crashes are now logged to an error.log file as well.[/list]

Improved general keyboard-accessibility.
Improved the Steam Cloud dialog to be more clear, and added a disclaimer.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
The first update for Nimble Writer - version 1.01 - is now live on Steam. It adds a bunch of day one stability fixes, and a couple much requested new features.

There will be a lot more coming in the next few days, so keep an eye out for that. Thanks to everyone for giving their feedback and suggestions so far! You can report feedback on the Steam discussion forums here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/348200/discussions/

[list][*]Added a dropdown box to the LanguageTool dialog for manually selecting a language.
[*]Added more spellchecker dictionaries for a few more languages.
[*]Added justified text alignment formatting.
[*]Added a setting to the PDF exporting dialog for exporting every paragraph as justify-aligned text.
[*]Improved note importing from URLs.
[*]Fixed LanguageTool not processing newly written text sometimes.
[*]Fixed problem in LanguageTool mother tongue not working properly when using Australian or British English versions.
[*]Fixed some bugs in the spellchecker when using unicode characters.
[*]Fixed the Encryption dialog not always showing all information.
[*]Fixed a rare crash when making bookmarks or doodles.
[*]Fixed notes reloading when you click on them more than once.[/list]
